findings: Original HB130 table and HB133 narrative both print 35 road-wheel teeth; the 9:37 ratio statement remains a separate unresolved assertion.
HB132 original identifies 23.031 inches and 23 chain teeth with the chain-sprocket/roller-pinion casting.
HB133 legend identifies M1406 inner bearing, M1407 outer bearing, M1411 shaft-nut locking plate and M1552 bearing plate; the source catalogue scopes common parts across drive and pinion shafts.
HB134 confirms the 27.625-inch shaft length, 4.434-inch diameter and common 8-inch M1409 bush.
The chain case has two parts and the source describes removing the drive wheel and roller pinion for access; geometry must reserve these distinct components.
Original HB119 explicitly prints 9 to 37; it conflicts with the two 35-tooth assertions on original HB130 and HB133.
SNL Plate27 depicts the drive wheel and shaft-bearing plate, matching the HB86 arrangement; this oblique image is not a metric tooth profile.
HB Plate119 is the same oblique wheel arrangement with marked part identities; it supplies no independent metric tooth or rim-land section.
